text: 财政部副部长廖岷在北京应约与英国财政部国际金融事务总司长林赛·怀特举行视频通话，就中英经济财金合作、中英在二十国集团财金渠道合作等议题交换意见。 （财政部网站）
text_en: Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min held a video call in Beijing with Lindsey Whyte, Director General for International Finance at the UK Treasury, at the latter's request, to exchange views on China-UK economic and financial cooperation and China-UK cooperation through the G20 finance track. (Ministry of Finance website)
